name: smwmusic-mario-eisouoku-illusionary-blossom-of-cranium-prayer-course-clear
title: Mario Eisouoku ~ Illusionary Blossom of Cranium Prayer - Course Clear
description:
The goal theme from マリオ永草億　～ Illusionary Blossom of Cranium Prayer.

It's a Touhou-style remix of the SMW goal music.

Note that, with the default SMW goal, the song will cut out abruptly at the end once the iris animation starts. It's not disruptive or anything, but still worth noting.
